instruction: Look at hard-02_seed.dxf. For this task, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-02_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'oblique truss lift bracket with reliefs' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, RIB. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(190,0); OUTLINE (190,0)->(190,40); OUTLINE (190,40)->(145,40); OUTLINE (145,40)->(125,100); OUTLINE (125,100)->(60,100); OUTLINE (60,100)->(42,40); OUTLINE (42,40)->(0,40); OUTLINE (0,40)->(0,0); RIB (20,20)->(170,20); RIB (42,40)->(125,100); RIB (60,100)->(145,40); RIB (95,0)->(95,100); RIB (0,40)->(190,40); CUTOUT (90,52)->(90,88); CUTOUT (100,52)->(100,88). Required circles: HOLE center (30,20) radius 6; HOLE center (160,20) radius 6; HOLE center (70,70) radius 7; HOLE center (120,70) radius 7; HOLE center (95,55) radius 10. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (42,40) radius 12 start 180 end 270; CUTOUT center (145,40) radius 12 start 270 end 0; CUTOUT center (95,88) radius 5 start 0 end 180; CUTOUT center (95,52) radius 5 start 180 end 0. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H02; ANNOTATION text OBLIQUE-7DEG. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
